verdict: A near pixel-faithful rebuild with every text, icon and image in place; the clearest gaps are the save/share buttons sitting ~8 dp too far right and a rounder image card, and it is a well-named auto-layout tree with instanced tabs and nav items but no shared styles or variables.

top_defects.where: Save and share buttons on the featured image
top_defects.what: both circles about 22 px (~8 dp) further right than the reference (bookmark centre x~829 vs ~807 px), leaving a tighter right inset than the reference's 16 dp
corner radius about 24 dp instead of the reference's 16 dp (top-right curve spans ~67 px vs ~40 px)

top_defects.where: Bottom navigation and the article card above it
top_defects.what: the bar starts ~3-4 px higher; the summary card ends with rounded bottom corners above the bar, whereas in the reference it runs on and is clipped under it
outline drawn as a full pill and the dark EN box slightly larger (~58 vs ~52 px wide) than the reference's rounded rectangle

top_defects.where: Module description, article title and last extract line
top_defects.what: same wrapping but glyphs drift by 1-2 px toward the line ends (heatmap red on the second half of 'the highest-quality articles on' and 'Hussars'), a small advance/letter-spacing mismatch
badge image offset/scaled by a pixel or two: every edge of the photo shows in the heatmap (grid row 3 meanDiff 10-14)

strengths: Every text of the reference present and exact, with identical wrapping and the 'Tr…' truncation; Roboto and Noto Serif at the right sizes and weights
All icons are the right glyphs at the right size and color, including the red 'new' dots on Saved and Activity, the Wikipedia wordmark as vectors and the globe
Clear named hierarchy (Status bar, App bar, Tabs row, Community banner, Featured article card, Bottom navigation) built with auto-layout, tabs and nav items as instances
